title: Physics-guided deep metric learning with continuous time embeddings for open-world radar pulse de-interleaving
abstract: arXiv:2609.25057v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Radar pulse de-interleaving is a foundational Electronic Support Measures (ESM) task that aims to separate chronologically interleaved pulse streams from multiple non-cooperative transmitters under unknown emitter cardinality in dense, contested electromagnetic environments. Classical histogram transforms and closed-world deep classifiers degrade under severe pulse loss, agile Pulse Repeti tion Interval (PRI) modulation, and spurious clutter. In this paper, we systematically characterise continuous temporal representations and physics-guided model selection in deep metric learning for open-world radar de-interleaving. Building on the transformer-based metric-learning framework for open-world deinterleaving introduced by Gunn et al. translated_title: 基于连续时间嵌入的物理引导深度度量学习用于开放世界雷达脉冲分选
translated_abstract: 雷达脉冲去交织（分选）是电子支援措施（ESM）中的一项基础任务，其目标是在密集且充满对抗的电磁环境中，在辐射源数量未知的情况下，将来自多个非合作发射机的时间上交错的脉冲流分离出来。经典的直方图变换方法和封闭世界深度分类器在严重脉冲丢失、捷变脉冲重复间隔（PRI）调制以及杂散杂波条件下性能会显著下降。在本文中，我们系统地研究了用于开放世界雷达去交织的深度度量学习中的连续时间表示与物理引导的模型选择。在Gunn等人[1]提出的基于Transformer的开放世界去交织度量学习框架基础上，我们引入了一种连续的到达时间正弦位置编码，直接对物理上的脉冲间持续时间进行建模，而非使用序数标记索引，这一设计选择与……
tldr: 本文提出一种物理引导的深度度量学习方法，通过连续到达时间正弦位置编码直接建模脉冲间的物理时间间隔，从而在辐射源数量未知、脉冲丢失和PRI捷变等复杂条件下提升开放世界雷达脉冲分选的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a physics-guided deep metric learning approach that introduces continuous Time-of-Arrival sinusoidal positional encodings to directly model physical inter-pulse durations, enhancing the robustness of open-world radar pulse de-interleaving under unknown emitter cardinality, pulse loss, and agile PRI modulation.
